effect_description_eng: [When Moving] [On Play] Reveal the top 3 cards of your deck. Add 1 card with [Dracomon] or [Examon] in its text among them to the hand. Return the rest to the bottom of the deck.
inherited_effect_description_eng: [End of Your Turn] This Digimon and any of your other Digimon may DNA digivolve into a Digimon card in the hand.
